value.answer: Assuming you mean Oakville, Ontario: there's no Costco open in Oakville yet. The first one is being built on Wyecroft Rd near Burloak Dr, with a target opening in fall 2027. A deals site says the Laird Rd warehouse at 3180 Laird Rd in Mississauga serves Oakville, but I couldn't confirm that on Costco's own site. Burlington has one too. I couldn't check hours or how far each one is from you, so I can't tell you which is closest.
